description: This site sets no tracking cookies. If you agree, your browser remembers which quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths you have completed. That stays on this device only. Without your consent, your progress lasts for this visit only.

essential.description: Basic functions like language setting and theme selection. These are always stored locally.
essential.title: Technically Necessary Functions

progress.description: Saves which quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths you have completed, locally in your browser. Off until you switch it on; switch it off again and the saved progress is deleted.
progress.title: Learning Progress

analytics.description: Helps me improve this site. With your consent, I collect page views, time spent, scroll depth, and device information (browser, screen size). This data is sent exclusively to my own server — not to third parties. Attribution is done via a daily-changing hash; your IP address is not stored. What exactly I collect and what I learn from it is shown transparently on the statistics page.
analytics.title: Usage Statistics

settingsDescription: Choose which data should be stored locally
title: About Cookies
